## Remarks

Fixed-angle presets are implemented on the server by continuously updating `attachedToPosition` and `targetPosition`<!-- -->, so they work with the current client protocol without requiring a separate camera runtime mode.

`SIDE_VIEW_2D` requests the client orthographic renderer preset by sending a non-positive FOV. Pair it with custom movement and art rules if you want a fully 2D game feel.
